description_en: Describes the syntax and examples for the DetectPedestrian operation in the facebody category
description_zh: 本文介绍人脸人体（facebody）类目下的人体检测DetectPedestrian的语法及示例
name: DetectPedestrian

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the image. An OSS URL in the China (Shanghai) region is recommended. For local files or OSS URLs in other regions, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.
Input limits:

Image format: JPEG, JPG, PNG, or BMP.
Image size: up to 4 MB.
Image resolution: The resolution is greater than 32 × 32 pixels and less than 2000 × 2000 pixels. The longest side is less than 2000 pixels. The face size is no less than 64 × 64 pixels.
The URL cannot contain Chinese characters.
If the image resolution exceeds the maximum limit, resize the image first. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/44688.html
parameters.help_zh:
图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。
输入限制：

图像格式：JPEG、JPG、PNG、BMP。
图像大小：不超过4 MB。
图像分辨率：分辨率大于32×32， 分辨率小于2000×2000像素，最长边小于2000像素， 人脸占比不低于64×64像素。
URL地址中不能包含中文字符。
当图像分辨率超过最大限制时，请先将图片进行缩放，调整图片大小，具体请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/44688.html
parameters.name: image_url

Elements.description_en: The collection of pedestrian detection boxes

items.description_en: The coordinates of the detection box in the `[left, top, right, bottom]` format. `left` is the x-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the pedestrian detection box, `top` is the y-coordinate of the upper-left corner, `right` is the x-coordinate of the lower-right corner, and `bottom` is the y-coordinate of the lower-right corner
items.description_zh: 检测框坐标，格式为`[left, top, right, bottom]`。其中`left`为人体检测框左上角横坐标，`top`为人体检测框左上角纵坐标，`right`为人体检测框右下角横坐标，`bottom`为人体检测框右下角纵坐标

Score.description_en: The confidence score of the detection box. Valid values: 0 to 1. A score closer to 1 indicates a higher probability that the pedestrian detection box is accurate
Score.description_zh: 检测框的置信度，取值范围为0~1，得分越接近1表示人体框准确的概率越大

Type.description_en: The type of the detection result for the detection box. Only the value `person` is returned
Type.description_zh: 检测框对应的检测结果类型。仅返回参数值`person`

Height.description_en: The height of the input image. Unit: pixels
Height.description_zh: 输入图像的高度，单位像素

Width.description_en: The width of the input image. Unit: pixels
Width.description_zh: 输入图像的宽度，单位像素
